title.zh: S&P Global to Acquire OpenZeppelin in Onchain Risk Push
title.en: S&P Global to Acquire OpenZeppelin in Onchain Risk Push

current_state.zh: S&P Global is acquiring smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, which will retain its name and audit team, as the ratings agency expands from financial risk assessments into onchain technology risk.
